notes: The engine is Shadowmoor and Eventide colorless commons plus four type-hack enchantments, which is about as esoteric as a kindred shell gets; Pili-Pala with Grand Architect and Painter's Servant with Grindstone are both two-card packages rather than staple combos. Fun is high because almost every turn asks which permanent to answer, what to imprint on Prototype Portal, and when to spend the Cauldron tap. Oppressiveness sits at seven and not lower because repeated unconditional permanent destruction is exactly the thing that takes decisions away from the table, even though the deck is slow and has almost no instant-speed interaction. Identity is near the top: twenty-five printed Scarecrows and ten changelings mean the tribe is the engine, and the destruction score is held to eight only because every trigger is gated on the commander surviving.
